label: DEMO. Separate from the step 8 experiment: never scored with it, never pooled with it.
declared_by: Claude agent (intent-demo prep), before any demo call or episode
rules: Episodes run strictly in this order, one each, all on layout 4004 with P0 and policy seed 0.
Every episode that starts is shown: a clip, its evidence and its checker output. None is rerun or dropped.
The launch chooses a stop point (2, 4 or 6). Episodes after it, or after an operator STOP, are listed as not run.
Each request goes to Nemotron 3 times. The robot gets repeat 1, and only if all 3 are valid and agree.

requests.text: put the banana beside the bowl, on its left
pick up the bowl and put it on the banana
requests.robot: not run unless Nemotron and the local rule both call it attemptable (expected: neither does)

episodes.request: put the banana beside the bowl, on its left
put the banana beside the bowl, on its left
put the banana beside the bowl, on its left

stop_points.what: two runs per attempted request with Nemotron's sentence
plus one run each with the user's raw words and no Nemotron (ablation)

why_layout_4004: P0 won it in the before phase (v5.1 pass, live v4 pass in 59 s). The banana starts on the robot's right, 9.5 cm from the rim, so neither left_of nor beside holds at the start, and there is 0.24 m of table left of the bowl. 4003, the layout suggested in the brief, was a P0 failure (never_lifted).
